Source: CONTRIBUTING.md

Contributing to the project is really quite simple:

  1. Read the contributor code of conduct at https://github.com/larnsce/lse.de/blob/master/code_of_conduct.md.
  2. Everything starts with an issue. See Always start with an issue for the philosophy.
    • Is the documentation unclear? File an issue.
    • Did you find a bug? File an issue.
    • Do you want to request a feature? File an issue.

Please, don’t go through the mechanics of forking / pull requests even for trivial typo changes without filing an issue. File an issue.

Copied and adapted from: https://github.com/znmeb/algocompsynth.com/blob/master/CONTRIBUTING.md
